# Emoji (Google Noto animated, Microsoft Fluent stills)

Status: **installed.** The files below were downloaded once, after the owner approved each one (name, source, size), and live in
`engine/public/stickers/emoji/` so Remotion can serve them with `staticFile()`. A scene that names a missing file stops with a message that points here.

- Noto animated emoji are licensed **CC BY 4.0**: the required credit and licence link are in `NOTICE-noto-animated-emoji.md` and `NOTICE.md`.
- Fluent emoji are **MIT** licensed (`LICENSE-fluent-emoji`), credited in `NOTICE.md`.

Credits live only in these files and `NOTICE.md`, never on videos or the studio screen.

## Sources

- **Google Noto Animated Emoji** (CC BY 4.0): https://googlefonts.github.io/noto-emoji-animation/
  Files are fetched from `https://fonts.gstatic.com/s/e/notoemoji/latest/`. Licence text: `third-party/emoji/NOTICE-noto-animated-emoji.md`.
- **Microsoft Fluent Emoji** (MIT): https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui-emoji
  Files are fetched from `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/microsoft/fluentui-emoji/1ffb34c752ecf5d402f04cfb4b392c77f57c54bc/assets/`. Licence text: `third-party/emoji/LICENSE-fluent-emoji`.

The Noto url contains `latest` (Google does not publish a versioned path), so the install records the size of every file and refuses a different size.
